body.message:
Hi, I genuinely like the apartment and would be interested in moving forward. However, AED 6,500 per month is beyond what I can reasonably commit to, especially as I travel frequently and the current situation..and the apartment would be lightly occupied.
My best offer is AED 5,000 per month, If the landlord accepts, I’m ready to proceed immediately and finalise the agreement without further negotiation. I would also be a responsible tenant and take excellent care of the property.
Please discuss my offer directly with the landlord, as I’m serious and ready to close at this amount.
